title: Aloperine mitigates cigarette smoke-induced inflammation and pyroptosis by inhibiting the BRD4/NLRP3/GSDMD pathway in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
authors: Li, Xiaofeng; Wang, Zhe; Zhang, Tingting; Zeng, Xiaoli; Li, Xin; Liu, Kai; Huang, Ping; Liu, Xiaoju
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦参碱通过抑制BRD4/NLRP3/GSDMD通路缓解COPD炎症，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and progressive airflow limitation, primarily caused by cigarette smoke (CS) exposure. Current pharmacological interventions for COPD merely slow disease progression, which further underscores the urgent need for innovative therapeutics. Aloperine has demonstrated potent anti-inflammatory properties, yet its therapeutic potential in COPD remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the effects and mechanisms of aloperine using a CS-induced COPD mouse model and a cigarette smoke extract (CSE)-stimulated alveolar macrophage (AM; MH-S cell) model. Aloperine treatment significantly improved pulmonary function and alleviated emphysema in COPD mice. Furthermore, it suppressed CSE-induced alveolar macrophage pyroptosis and inflammatory responses both in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, the bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) inhibitor-JQ1-attenuated CSE-induced pyroptosis; however, this effect was partially reversed by the NLRP3 activator- nigericin. Comprehensive analyses, including results from molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, surface plasmon resonance, and in vivo and in vitro experiments, supported that aloperine interacts with BRD4 and attenuates NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis. Collectively, our findings indicate that aloperine alleviates CS-induced airway inflammation and pyroptosis potentially by modulating the BRD4/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling, positioning it as a promising therapeutic candidate for COPD.
abstract_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）以持续性气道炎症和进行性气流受限为特征，主要由香烟烟雾（CS）暴露引起。目前针对COPD的药物干预仅能延缓疾病进展，这进一步凸显了对创新治疗方法的迫切需求。苦参碱（Aloperine）已显示出强效的抗炎特性，但其在COPD中的治疗潜力尚不明确。在本研究中，我们利用CS诱导的COPD小鼠模型和香烟烟雾提取物（CSE）刺激的肺泡巨噬细胞（AM；MH-S细胞）模型，探讨了苦参碱的作用及机制。苦参碱治疗显著改善了COPD小鼠的肺功能并减轻了肺气肿。此外，它在体内和体外均抑制了CSE诱导的肺泡巨噬细胞焦亡和炎症反应。机制上，含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）抑制剂JQ1减弱了CSE诱导的焦亡；然而，这一效应被NLRP3激活剂尼日利亚菌素（nigericin）部分逆转。综合分析，包括分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟、表面等离子体共振以及体内和体外实验的结果，支持苦参碱与BRD4相互作用并减弱NLRP3介导的焦亡。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，苦参碱可能通过调节BRD4/NLRP3/GSDMD信号通路来缓解CS诱导的气道炎症和焦亡，使其成为COPD的有前景的治疗候选药物。
